recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit source/processresponse for the current build; if historical ProcessResponse material is ever republished, review it against the FHIR-19345 removal/use-Task disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-18026 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management issue for ProcessResponse Scope and Usage. It asked whether ProcessResponse could be replaced by Task and, if not, to expand the documentation to describe other situations where ProcessResponse may be used as a response.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-18026 was found. The historical ProcessResponse page already had a Task refactoring note and PaymentNotice response wording before the issue. The same-day FHIR-19345 issue then supplied the decisive application path by removing ProcessRequest and ProcessResponse from active build metadata and moving financial process guidance to Task.
additional_context: FHIR-19345 is Published/Persuasive and says FM determined Task can meet the purposes of ProcessRequest and ProcessResponse. Current fhir.ini comments ProcessResponse out of active resources, lists it only as a removed resource, and annotates it as approved to use Task. The active Financial Module maps Payment Notice and related process workflows to Task, and workflow minutes support removing ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse. FHIR-19345 was already represented on the combined branch by f6ea10ab, so no duplicate related commit was published.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active specification should not expand out-of-build ProcessResponse documentation because the issue family resolved the threshold question in favor of Task replacement.
